create_bit_diffusion_pipeline: create a BitDiffusion pipeline with a UNet and DDIM scheduler for bit-level image generation
run_ddim_scheduler_step: run the DDIM scheduler step with bit-scale clamping for diffusion sampling
run_ddpm_scheduler_step: run the DDPMScheduler step with bit-scale clamping for diffusion sampling
convert_decimal_to_bits: convert a decimal image tensor in [0,1] to a bit representation in [-1,1]
convert_bits_to_decimal: convert a bit tensor in [-1,1] back to a decimal image tensor in [0,1]
